WORLD BANK GROUP RESPONSE AND STRATEGY

Following the earthquake, the Government asked the World Bank Group to

10.

reprogramming of resources from ongoing projects towards reconstruction efforts; fast

disbursement of upcoming projects, including through allowing the retroactive financing

of eligible expenditures; preparation of an emergency recovery loan that will (inter alia)

provide income support and housing recovery support to poor households that have
